parameters.name: DeliveryOssBucketName
parameters.description: The name of the OSS bucket.

parameters.name: DeliveryOssEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the delivery of template execution records to Object Storage Service (OSS). The default value is `false`.

parameters.name: DeliveryOssKeyPrefix
parameters.description: The key prefix of the OSS bucket. For example, `oos/execution`. To clear a previously configured prefix, set this parameter to an empty string (`""`).

parameters.name: DeliverySlsEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable the delivery of template execution records to SLS. The default value is `false`.

parameters.name: DeliverySlsProjectName
parameters.description: The name of the Log Service (SLS) project.
